final_assessment: Sal ratified SHIP BOTH SHAPES (D-rc04-14), and the slot's field shape fell out of the four qualifying judgements rather than needing design (D-rc04-15). ONE SPINE, two kinds. Every record carries kind, a NON-EMPTY formed_against list of independent pass TOKENS, a disposition whose value set varies by kind, prose reasoning under R-crc-10, and ratified_by — that last one required because D-rc04-3 as amended makes the difference between the AI's own belief and a Sal ratification something the record must state rather than imply. kind continuation is formed mid-cadence with disposition proceed (past a gate saying no, which is today's gate_overridden) or spend (buy a further pass past a gate saying yes, which has no home at all); the proceed case carries gate, gate_state and gate_reason, exactly gate_overridden's existing payload, so the generalisation is ADDITIVE and nothing is lost. kind readiness is terminal with disposition ready or not-ready, and carries accepted as a list of claim/why pairs — the residuals are the assertion's CONTENT rather than peer judgements, and rc02c's would have held three. THE ENGINE RULE is the only computed thing: every token in formed_against must precede the record's own timestamp or the write gate REFUSES it, using the materialize-first shape orbit-emit-composition already has. That is exit (3) finally with something to check, because the citation is BY TOKEN where gate_overridden's is prose. Verified against rc02c's archived trail that NO NEW TRAIL LOCATION is needed: continuation/proceed lands on the apply and archive emits, continuation/spend on the review-external T0 emit written at exactly the moment that decision is taken, readiness on the archive emit. The stage adds fields to three existing payload tables and invents no fourth trail. Eighteen decisions now; two small leanings remain — whether a not-ready readiness record blocks the archive or merely records the routing (leaning record-only, since blocking re-creates the target-shaped signal R-crc-11(h) retires), and whether gate_overridden is retired outright or deprecated for a release (leaning retire, since a deprecated alias for a record with no readers is ceremony). Both are method calls under R-crc-3 rather than scope, so the exploration is effectively ready to promote.
